_help: Edit this file and commit it to main. GitHub wakes the auto-blog workflow every hour and this file decides whether to publish. The live cycle is frequency interval and intervalMinutes 20160, which is 14 days after the last successful publication in content/blog-schedule-state.json. Timezone Asia/Kolkata is used for clock-based frequencies; the 14-day gap is measured from lastRunAt and does not observe daylight saving. mode publish writes one new post. postsPerRun must stay 1 so a retry cannot publish a backlog. maxRuns null means the cycle does not end. A failed run must not update lastRunAt. Resetting lastRunAt makes the next post due 14 days after that timestamp.
